trophyRules.note: Every cosmetic is a trophy. Visual only. No spending, no prices. Unlocks are awarded automatically, once each, by ledger id unlock:<id>. Each slot equips one item (cardFrame: oak, silver, gold, hearts). Equipping is free and never changes progress.

picPlan.rule: Picture-recall cards show ONE picture of the ANSWER. pic = emoji string (Apple Color Emoji, offline on iOS), 'svg:<id>' (draw it), or null (fallback: zone emblem at 40% + Thai definition enlarged in the frame). The English answer is never shown before she answers.
